#include <bits/stdc++.h>

#define dbg(x) cerr << #x << " = " << (x) << endl
#define raya cerr << "-------------------" << endl

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct step {
	ll val; int cost;
	bool operator<(const step &c) const {
		return c.cost < cost;
	}
};

set<ll> visited;

bool wasVisited(ll c) {
	return visited.find(c) != visited.end();
}

step uupper(ll n){
	ll res = 0;
	int i = 0;
	while(res<n){
		res*=10;
		res++;
		i++;
	}
	return {res, i};
}

step upper(ll n){
	ll res = 0;
	int i = 0;
	while(res*10+1<=n){
		res*=10;
		res++;
		i++;
	}
	ll resmul = res;
	int imul = i;
	while(res < n){
		res+=resmul;
		i+=imul;
	}
	return {res, i};
}

step lower(ll n){
	ll res = 0;
	int i = 0;
	while(res*10+1<=n){
		res*=10;
		res++;
		i++;
	}
	ll resmul = res;
	int imul = i;
	while(res+resmul <= n){
		res+=resmul;
		i+=imul;
	}
	return {res, i};
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
	ll n;
	cin >> n;

	priority_queue<step> pq;

	pq.push(step{n, 0});

	while(pq.top().val != 0){
		ll val = pq.top().val;
		int cost = pq.top().cost;
		pq.pop();

		if(wasVisited(val))
			continue;
		visited.insert(val);

		for (step next : { lower(val), upper(val), uupper(val) }) {
			next.cost += cost;
			next.val = abs(val - next.val);
			pq.push(next);

		}

	}

	cout << pq.top().cost << endl;
}
